name: Pimoroni Inky Impression 4" (ACeP, 640x400, legacy)
description: Legacy 4 inch 7-colour ACeP (E Ink) HAT for Raspberry Pi, 640x400. Pre-dates the Spectra 6 refresh Pimoroni now ships under the same product name; the current shipping SKU is pimoroni_inky_4 (600x400 Spectra 6). Driven by the pi_bin client on a 7-colour palette; the ACeP nibble packing path in pi_bin is less well-exercised than the Spectra 6 path, please open an issue if the paint is off after a fresh flash.
notes_md: Awaiting confirmed test on real hardware. If you own the current 600x400 Spectra 6 variant, use `pimoroni_inky_4` instead; the two panels share the product name but not the panel dims or the ink chemistry, so picking the wrong kind will paint at the wrong resolution.
